name: Armored Carriage

items.name: Weapon Mount
items.text: This vehicle has one rear weapon mount that can be equipped with a ranged weapon. At purchase, this weapon mount is empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into this mount requires 10 minutes, a successful DC 20 Crafting check, as well as an appropriate weapon to install.

items.name: Wind-Up
items.text: 10 minutes of wind-up, 1 hour of operational time, DC 20, standby

text: Slow but steady, an armored carriage combines clockwork with a protective hull for a safe and comfortable ride.
